title: Plains of Eidolon/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Transmissions during general Plains of Eidolon Bounties.

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: > “A Grineer leader will only show their face if we disrupt Grineer operations across several fronts.”
> “A new Grineer commander has been no end of trouble. Capture them.”
> —Capture the New Grineer Commander In-Game Description

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: - Konzu: "New Grineer boss-man's been givin' us no end of trouble. You're my go-to Tenno. Make him go away, yeah?"
- Lotus: "Konzu is right. We must create chaos to draw this Grineer Commander into an open fight."

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: - Lotus: "I'm tracking a Grineer drone with information about our target. Bring it to me."
- Lotus: "The drone is ours. Analyzing data stream. Excellent, a possible lead."

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: - Lotus: "Seized intelligence has revealed the location of the Commander's camp. Liberate it from him."
- Lotus: "We've captured the camp. The Commander has retreated to a new position."

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: - Lotus: "The Commander has requested a supply drop to quell unrest among his troops. Intercept the drop to keep them on edge."
- Lotus: "Radio chatter indicates falling morale within the Grineer ranks. That's bad news for the Commander."

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: - Lotus: "Our target is about to receive pieces of a communications array in a supply drop. Interrupt the drop and destroy the equipment."
- Lotus: "Their comms just lit up. They're not happy about what you just did. Let's keep it that way."

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
lines: - Lotus: "The Commander is in the area. Scanning... he's hiding. Okay, Tenno, see if you can draw the Commander out."
- Konzu: "Lights out for boss-man. You're off the clock, Tenno."

path: Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
Final Stage: Capture the New Grineer Commander (Capture)
lines: - Lotus: "I've located the Commander. He's moving on foot. Intercept and bring him in alive."
- Konzu: "Good work, Tenno. I'm about to show boss-man some Ostron 'hospitality'. Sho-lah."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: > “An item of great importance to the Quills has been taken by the Grineer. Locate the agent who stole it and bring him in.”
> “The Grineer have taken an Orokin artifact. Find where they have stashed it.”
> “The Quills say the Grineer have stolen a precious Orokin artifact. Steal it back.”

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Konzu: "The Quills are at it again. Telling me an important Orokin relic is being unearthed by the Grineer. The Quills would like this relic back, and I would like to keep the Quills happy. Will you oblige?"
- Lotus: "Details about this relic and its whereabouts are scarce. I need you to do some digging."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "At my waypoint, you'll find the Commander responsible for taking the relic. Eliminate him."
- Lotus: "With that Commander eliminated, the Quills' relics are much safer. But we still need to find the one they have."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "Scans indicate the Grineer have a hidden supply cache at this waypoint. Search the area for the relic."
- Lotus: "No sign of the relic. But the Grineer will not be happy about losing those resources."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "Quick. The Grineer archaeologist who uncovered the relic is on the move. Bring them in for questioning."
- Lotus: "Interrogation complete. We have new leads to investigate."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "The Grineer have been using drones to perform subsurface scans of the Plains. Hijack one for me."
- Lotus: "The drone had a complete imprint of the relic. I know what to look for now."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "This camp is the command point for Grineer archaeological operations. Shut them down."
- Lotus: "The relic was here, and not long ago. We'll keep hunting."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "I've learned of an Ostron miner who was captured by the Grineer. Bring him home."
- Lotus: "Thanks to that miner we have new leads on the relic's location."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
lines: - Lotus: "Our latest intel points to the armored vault at my waypoint. Break in and look for the relic."
- Lotus: "Too late. The Grineer moved the relic already."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
Final Stage: Capture the Grineer Agent (Capture)
lines: - Lotus: "I'm tracking a Grineer agent in possession of the relic. It appears he's trying to get it off the Plains on foot. Capture him, and the relic."
- Konzu: "You captured the relic and the Grineer archaeologist? He and I are going to have an interesting conversation. Dah-dap, Tenno."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
Final Stage: Find the Hidden Artifact (Cache Recovery)
lines: - Lotus: "They're trying to hide the relic on us in the hopes we'll forget about it and call the search off. Search the caches near my waypoint to recover it."
- Konzu: "Ah, there it is. Beautiful-utz. Sho-lah, Tenno."

path: Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
Final Stage: Reclaim the Stolen Artifact (Resource Theft)
lines: - Lotus: "I located the relic. The Grineer hid it in an armored vault at my waypoint. Go. Quick."
- Konzu: "The relic! You found it! The Quills will be very happy to hear this... or, they would be, if they were capable of emotion. Either way, I'm happy. Bounty paid."
> “A high-ranking Grineer has landed on the Plains. Bring them to the Lotus.”
- Konzu: "The Quills say some high-up Commander is here to inspect the troops. Sent by the Queens, they say. So, send the Queens a message: their troops are not welcome near Cetus."
- Lotus: "Konzu's intel aligns with my own. A high-ranking Grineer Commander landed on the Plains hours ago, but his precise location is still a mystery. Let's track him down."
- Lotus: "Intel suggests the Commander has released surveillance drones onto the Plains to complete his assessment. Find one and bring it to me."
- Lotus: "Scanning the drone's systems... here we go. Stand by for coordinates."
- Lotus: "I've found the Commander's camp. Liberate it from Grineer control."
- Lotus: "The Commander has one less place to hide."
- Lotus: "Resources plundered from the Plains and destined to be a tribute for the Queens are being held in the armored vault near my waypoint. Make sure the Queens see none of this bounty."
- Lotus: "The Commander is going to have a hard time fleeing without his tribute for the Queens. He's stuck here. Now we find him."
- Lotus: "The Commander is having special supplies sent in just for him. Intercept the shipment and destroy it."
- Lotus: "Comms just lit up. The Commander's subordinates are all trying to deflect blame. Let's see if they drop any more intel."

path: Final Stage: Capture the Grineer Commander (Capture)
lines: - Lotus: "Our Commander has run out of options. Find him at the waypoint and capture him for me. I have questions I want him to answer."
- Konzu: "Lotus has the Commander in her custody? He won't be sleeping too good tonight. But I will. Dah-dap, surah, haha!"

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: > “Deal a blow to a Grineer detachment’s morale by capturing their commander.”
> “The Grineer grow too strong in number. Weaken them.”
> “Expel the Grineer from their outpost on the Plains.”

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Konzu: "Plains living is tough living. Grineer are finding that out the hard way. Let's make 'em find out a little faster. Cut off their supplies."
- Lotus: "Konzu is right; the Grineer can never be allowed to live comfortably on the Plains. Let's make this place as inhospitable as possible for them."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "The Commander in charge of this detachment is hiding somewhere near my waypoint. Draw them out and eliminate them."
- Lotus: "The loss of that Commander will lead to uncertainty and infighting among his former troops. Good work."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "Emergency Grineer supply caches are hidden in the vicinity of my waypoint. Empty them."
- Lotus: "With that last cache, you sent a message to this detachment: nothing they have is safe."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "I need you to recover a Grineer drone so that I can access its logs."
- Lotus: "Thank you. I can use the codes in this Grineer drone to sow confusion within the Grineer ranks."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "Without supplies, the Grineer rank and file have fallen into disarray. This is the time to strike."
- Lotus: "The detachment won't soon recover from that strike. You've weakened them."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "I want you to liberate a key operations camp."
- Lotus: "Without control of that camp, their resources cannot move freely around the Plains."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "This Grineer detachment is running low on materiel. Let's hasten the process by taking out one of their armored supply vaults."
- Lotus: "Grineer troops were desperate for those supplies. Let's see if that got a reaction."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "You've left the Commander of this detachment weak and exposed. Capture him and let's see what he has to say."
- Konzu: "I was never able to imagine a future without Grineer. Now I can, thanks to you, Tenno."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
lines: - Lotus: "All your work has led to this. Take out as many Grineer as you can."
- Konzu: "Almost feel sorry for 'em. Then I remember what's been done to us, and I'm at peace. Here's your bounty. Swazdo-lah, Tenno."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
Final Stage: Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines (Supply Sabotage)
lines: - Lotus: "Thanks to you, Grineer morale is desperately low. Command wants to remedy the situation with a supply drop. Make sure that never happens."
- Konzu: "You got them itchin' to run home to the safety of their Galleons. Exactly what I wanted."

path: Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
Final Stage: Weaken the Grineer Foothold (Liberation)
lines: - Lotus: "You've weakened the Grineer detachment; now it's time to send them running. Force them out of their camp."
- Konzu: "Starved 'em out of house and home. I'd feel bad, but this isn't their house, or their home."
> “Prototype tech is being delivered to the Grineer. Scour the Plains until you find it!”

- Konzu: "The Quills whispered about some sort of new weapon the Grineer have. They've deployed in bits and pieces to avoid detection. They want to attack the Unum's tower and I don't want to find out if that's possible. Understand?"
- Lotus: "Disrupt and destroy anything associated with this weapons project. The Orokin Tower is what protects Cetus from the Grineer. We can't give them the opportunity to attack it."
- Lotus: "A Grineer science officer responsible for deploying the array has just arrived on the Plains. Bring him to me."
- Lotus: "Thank you, Tenno. This science officer will have much to tell us about his project."
- Lotus: "An Ostron patrol was able to knock out the array's control drone. Locate the downed drone before the Grineer."
- Lotus: "That's one piece of the puzzle. Now, for the rest."
- Lotus: "A regiment of Grineer combat engineers who have been ordered to assemble the weapons array is massing at my waypoint. Go there and take them out."
- Lotus: "That's enough. You've broken this regiment, and with it, the Grineer's ability to quickly deploy the array."
- Lotus: "Resources needed to assemble the weapons array are stored in an armored vault at my waypoint. Put them to better use."
- Lotus: "That strike has delayed Grineer operations significantly."
- Lotus: "Codes obtained from the science officer disabled the array's control drone. Find it and bring it to me."
- Konzu: "Ai yo, Tenno. You put that weapon on ice. Now the Unum's safe. Not that I ever worry much about the Unum."
> “An Ostron has gone missing on the Plains. Find them and bring them home.”
- Lotus: "We can't let the Grineer terrorize the people of Cetus. Find this trapper, and if he's alive, bring him back to safety."
- Lotus: "I've identified a drone that was active near the Ostron's last known location. Bring it to me so I can examine its logs."
- Lotus: "Just as I suspected. The Grineer drone saw the Ostron. We can use this information to help pinpoint his current location."
- Lotus: "We need to put the Grineer on alert, let them know the Ostrons are off-limits. Raid their camp and send them packing."
- Lotus: "During the chaos, I intercepted a transmission that confirms the Grineer are holding the Ostron prisoner."
- Lotus: "This Grineer Commander is likely responsible for the Ostron's disappearance. Bring them to me for questioning."
- Lotus: "An easy interrogation. Our prisoner is on the move. With more data, we can pinpoint the route."
- Lotus: "Tenno, with the intel you've gathered, I've managed to pinpoint the trapper's location. Rescue him."
- Konzu: "Our citizen is safe, and the Grineer now know what happens when you mess with our people. You earned this bounty, Tenno."
> “There's a Grineer spy in Cetus. Put pressure on the Grineer and force the spy out.”

- Konzu: "Shhh... we don't know who could be listening. Quills tell me there's a Grineer spy lurking in Cetus. As usual, they're short on details. Looking for you to put some pressure on the Grineer out there, so we can find the spy in here."
- Lotus: "Konzu has little information about the spy's identity or location. Collect enough intel to unmask this spy."
- Lotus: "I suspect the spy is communicating with nearby drones. I'll need to examine one to know for sure."
- Lotus: "Just as I thought. The spy was using that drone to relay information to Grineer command. You've cut off his line of communication."
- Lotus: "Take out this camp. Once liberated, I'll scan it for intel on the spy."
- Lotus: "Plenty of intel was left behind. I'm closer than ever to identifying the spy."
- Lotus: "Raid the Grineer resource vault at my location. I want to put them on edge, so they start making mistakes."
- Lotus: "Radio chatter during that strike gave away crucial details about the spy. The walls are closing in."
- Lotus: "The Grineer have just captured one of Konzu's scouts. Rescue them and see what they know."
- Lotus: "The scout has relayed crucial information about the Grineer spy."
- Lotus: "Thanks to you, the spy has been unmasked. They're fleeing Cetus on foot. Find them and bring them to me."
- Konzu: "Thank the Unum! Without you, we may have never have caught him. You earned this bounty, Tenno."
> “Narmer are all fired up. They just promoted a cultist to Commander rank. Go and demote him to dead.”
- Konzu: "The Narmer beast is wounded, but still kicking. Every time a new head grows, we must chop it off. Sending you after the latest veil-head boss, killer. You know what to do. Do-gah!"

- Konzu: "Never was much hope of reasoning with a Grineer. Even less hope when he's got a head full of blood-red Narmer visions. Ai yo. There'll be another one clapping on the veil he dropped, soon enough."
Rest of transmissions are shared with #Assassinate the Commander / Capture the New Grineer Commander
> “Narmer numbers are rising. They're planning something big. Cut them down before they march on Cetus again.”

- Konzu: "Narmer came after Cetus first. They crave to capture the Unum, and they have plenty of veiled-up die-hards to help them do it. Lucky for us we have you, eh? Go and help those die-hards to die a little easier."
- Konzu: "Good work, killer. One day, we will find out who is behind these new Narmer. And then? That person should pray we get to them before the Grineer do."
Rest of transmissions are shared with Cull the Enemy: #Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
> “Narmer are recruiting by force. They've taken one of our own and are planning a veiling ceremony. Stop them.”
- Konzu: "It is happening again. Once more they round us up, once more they clap their cursed veils on our faces. Bring our people back, surah. Show Narmer we will never submit."
- Konzu: "It is a terrible thing to mourn for one who still walks and still breathes. We lost many to the veils, surah, and many more to grief. You have saved far more than one life today."
Rest of transmissions are shared with Weaken the Grineer Foothold: #Capture Their Leader / Cull the Enemy / Sabotage Grineer Supply Lines / Weaken the Grineer Foothold
- Konzu: "Narmer holdouts are hoarding supplies: weapons, drones, and veils of course. Take the lot surah. Do not leave them a helmet to piss in!"
- Konzu: "All is one, eh? All their hard won gear is now ours. And does it make up for having our home scorched and cratered? We keep on, surah. What else is left for us to do?"
Rest of transmissions are shared with Reclaim the Stolen Artifact: #Capture the Grineer Agent / Find the Hidden Artifact / Reclaim the Stolen Artifact
